meaning:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.3:4 (דָּרַשׁ), Job.10:6 (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Luk.2:44-45 Act.11:25.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
